Document: Part 55 – Possession Claims
Part 2 of 3
==================================================
## Conditions for IPO application

## 55.21

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.21] (1) An application for an IPO may be made where the following conditions are satisfied –

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.21] (a) the only claim made is a possession claim against trespassers for the recovery of premises;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.21] (b) the claimant –

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.21] (i) has an immediate right to possession of the premises; and

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.21] (ii) has had such a right throughout the period of alleged unlawful occupation; and

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.21] (c) the claim is made within 28 days of the date on which the claimant first knew, or ought reasonably to have known, that the defendant (or any of the defendants), was in occupation. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.21] (2) An application for an IPO may not be made against a defendant who entered or remained on the premises with the consent of a person who, at the time consent was given, had an immediate right to possession of the premises. ## The application

## 55.22

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.22] (1) Rules 55.3(1) and (4) apply to the claim. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.22] (2) The claim form and the defendant’s form of witness statement must be in the form set out in Practice Direction 55A. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.22] (3) When he files his claim form, the claimant must also file –

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.22] (a) an application notice in the form set out in Practice Direction 55A; and

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.22] (b) written evidence. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.22] (4) The written evidence must be given –

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.22] (a) by the claimant personally; or

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.22] (b) where the claimant is a body corporate, by a duly authorised officer. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.22] (Rule 22.1(6)(b) provides that the statement of truth must be signed by the maker of the witness statement)

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.22] (5) The court will –

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.22] (a) issue –

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.22] (i) the claim form; and

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.22] (ii) the application for the IPO; and

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.22] (b) set a date for the hearing of the application. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.22] (6) The hearing of the application will be as soon as practicable but not less than 3 days after the date of issue. ## Service

## 55.23

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.23] (1) Within 24 hours of the issue of the application, the claimant must serve on the defendant –

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.23] (a) the claim form;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.23] (b) the application notice together with the written evidence in support; and

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.23] (c) a blank form for the defendant’s witness statement (as set out in Practice Direction 55A) which must be attached to the application notice. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.23] (2) The claimant must serve the documents listed in paragraph (1) in accordance with rule 55.6(a). [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.23] (3) At or before the hearing the claimant must file a certificate of service in relation to the documents listed in paragraph (1) and rule 6.17(2)(a) does not apply. ## Defendant’s response

## 55.24

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.24] (1) At any time before the hearing the defendant may file a witness statement in response to the application. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.24] (2) The witness statement should be in the form set out in Practice Direction 55A. ## Hearing of the application

## 55.25

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.25] (1) In deciding whether to grant an IPO, the court will have regard to whether the claimant has given, or is prepared to give, the following undertakings in support of his application –

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.25] (a) if, after an IPO is made, the court decides that the claimant was not entitled to the order to –

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.25] (i) reinstate the defendant if so ordered by the court; and

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.25] (ii) pay such damages as the court may order; and

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.25] (b) before the claim for possession is finally decided, not to –

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.25] (i) damage the premises;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.25] (ii) grant a right of occupation to any other person; and

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.25] (iii) damage or dispose of any of the defendant’s property. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.25] (2) The court will make an IPO if –

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.25] (a) the claimant has –

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.25] (i) filed a certificate of service of the documents referred to in rule 55.23(1); or

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.25] (ii) proved service of those documents to the satisfaction of the court; and

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.25] (b) the court considers that –

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.25] (i) the conditions set out in rule 55.21(1) are satisfied; and

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.25] (ii) any undertakings given by the claimant as a condition of making the order are adequate. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.25] (3) An IPO will be in the form set out in Practice Direction 55A and will require the defendant to vacate the premises specified in the claim form within 24 hours of the service of the order. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.25] (4) On making an IPO the court will set a date for the hearing of the claim for possession which will be not less than 7 days after the date on which the IPO is made. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.25] (5) Where the court does not make an IPO –

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.25] (a) the court will set a date for the hearing of the claim;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.25] (b) the court may give directions for the future conduct of the claim; and

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.25] (c) subject to such directions, the claim shall proceed in accordance with Section I of this Part. ## Service and enforcement of the IPO

## 55.26

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.26] (1) An IPO must be served within 48 hours after it is sealed. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.26] (2) The claimant must serve the IPO on the defendant together with copies of

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.26] (a) the claim form; and

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.26] (b) the written evidence in support, in accordance with rule 55.6(a). [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.26] (3) Rules 83.2, 83.3 and 83.26(1) to (9) do not apply to the enforcement of an IPO. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.26] (4) If an IPO is not served within the time limit specified by this rule, the claimant may apply to the court for directions for the claim for possession to continue under Section I of this Part. ## After IPO made

## 55.27

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.27] (1) Before the date for the hearing of the claim, the claimant must file a certificate of service in relation to the documents specified in rule 55.26(2). [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.27] (2) The IPO will expire on the date of the hearing of the claim. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.27] (3) At the hearing the court may make any order it considers appropriate and may, in particular –

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.27] (a) make a final order for possession;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.27] (b) dismiss the claim for possession;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.27] (c) give directions for the claim for possession to continue under Section I of this Part; or

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.27] (d) enforce any of the claimant’s undertakings. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.27] (4) Unless the court directs otherwise, the claimant must serve any order or directions in accordance with rule 55.6(a). [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.27] (5) Rule 83.26(10) to (12) applies to the enforcement of a final order for possession. ## Application to set aside IPO

## 55.28

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.28] (1) If the defendant has left the premises, he may apply on grounds of urgency for the IPO to be set aside before the date of the hearing of the claim. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.28] (2) An application under paragraph (1) must be supported by a witness statement. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.28] (3) On receipt of the application, the court will give directions as to –

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.28] (a) the date for the hearing; and

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.28] (b) the period of notice, if any, to be given to the claimant and the method of service of any such notice. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.28] (4) No application to set aside an IPO may be made under rule 39.3. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.28] (5) Where no notice is required under paragraph (3)(b), the only matters to be dealt with at the hearing of the application to set aside are whether –

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.28] (a) the IPO should be set aside; and

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.28] (b) any undertaking to re-instate the defendant should be enforced,

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.28] and all other matters will be dealt with at the hearing of the claim. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.28] (6) The court will serve on all the parties –

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.28] (a) a copy of the order made under paragraph (5); and

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.28] (b) where no notice was required under paragraph (3)(b), a copy of the defendant’s application to set aside and the witness statement in support. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.28] (7) Where notice is required under paragraph (3)(b), the court may treat the hearing of the application to set aside as the hearing of the claim. ## Stay of possession proceedings, coronavirus

## 55.29

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.29] Subject to paragraph (2), all possession proceedings brought under this Part and all enforcement proceedings by way of writ or warrant of possession that are—

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.29] (a )stayed immediately prior to this rule coming into force; or

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.29] (b) brought after this rule comes into force and on or before 19 September 2020,

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.29] are stayed until 20 September 2020. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.29] (2) Paragraph (1) does not apply to—

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.29] (a) a claim against trespassers to which rule 55.6 applies;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.29] (b) proceedings under Section III of this Part;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.29] (c) an application for case management directions that are agreed by all the parties; or

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.29] (d) a claim for injunctive relief. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.29] (3) Paragraph (1) does not prevent the bringing of a claim notwithstanding that it may be stayed. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.29] (4) For the purposes of the application of any rule to any proceedings that are stayed by paragraph (1)—

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.29] (a) time does not run; and

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.29] (b) no notice is required to be given by the court. ## IV RENTING HOMES WALES – GENERAL RULES

## Interpretation

## 55.30

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.30] In this Section of this Part—

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.30] (a)“the 2016 Act” means the Renting Homes (Wales) Act 2016 8 ;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.30] (b)“a contract-holder” is the person who makes an occupation contract with a landlord and is a contract-holder under sections 7 and 48 of the 2016 Act 9 ;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.30] (c)“Convention rights” has the meaning provided by the Human Rights Act 1998 10 ;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.30] (d)“a dwelling” means a dwelling let under an occupation contract;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.30] (e)“an extended possession order” means an order for possession against a sub-holder under section 65 11 of the 2016 Act;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.30] (f)“an occupation contract” is a tenancy or licence that is an occupation contract under section 7 of the 2016 Act;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.30] (g)“a prohibited conduct standard contract order claim” means a claim under section 116 12 of the 2016 Act;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.30] (h)“a Renting Homes possession claim” means a claim for the recovery of possession of a dwelling under the 2016 Act;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.30] (i)“a sub-holder” has the meaning provided by section 59 13 of the 2016 Act;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.30] (j)“a standard contract” has the meaning provided by section 8 14 of the 2016 Act. ## Scope

## 55.31

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.31] (1) The procedure set out in this Section of this Part must be used where the claim is a Renting Homes possession claim. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.31] (Where a prohibited conduct standard contract order claim is made in the same claim form in which a Renting Homes possession claim is made, this Section of this Part applies. Where the claim is a prohibited conduct standard contract order claim only, Section III of Part 65 applies.)

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.31] (2) This Section of this Part—

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.31] (a)is subject to any enactment or practice direction which sets out special provisions with regard to any particular category of claim;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.31] (b)does not apply where the claimant uses the procedure set out in Section V of this Part;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.31] (c)applies irrespective of whether an application for an extended possession order may be made in the course of the Renting Homes possession claim. ## Starting the claim

## 55.32

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.32] (1) In the County Court—

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.32] (a)the claimant may make the claim at any County Court hearing centre, unless paragraph (2) applies or an enactment provides otherwise;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.32] (b)the claim is to be issued by the hearing centre where the claim is made; and

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.32] (c)if that hearing centre does not serve the address where the dwelling is situated, the claim is to be sent, after issue, to the hearing centre serving that address. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.32] (Practice Direction 55A includes further direction in respect of claims which are not made at the County Court hearing centre which serves the address where the dwelling is situated.)

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.32] (2) The claim may be started in the High Court if the claimant files with their claim form a certificate stating the reasons for bringing the claim in that court verified by a statement of truth. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.32] (3) The claim form and form of defence sent with it must be in the forms specified in Practice Direction 55A. ## Particulars of claim

## 55.33

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.33] The particulars of claim must be filed and served with the claim form. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.33] (Part 16 and Practice Direction 55A provide details about the contents of the particulars of claim.)

## Hearing date

## 55.34

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.34] (1) Subject to paragraph (2), the court is to fix a date for the hearing when it issues the claim form. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.34] (2) If the claim has been sent on to the hearing centre which serves the address where the dwelling is situated, that hearing centre is to fix a date for hearing when it receives the claim. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.34] (3) In all Renting Homes possession claims—

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.34] (a)the hearing date is to be not less than 28 days from the date of issue of the claim form;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.34] (b)the standard period between the issue of the claim form and the hearing is to be not more than 8 weeks; and

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.34] (c)the defendant must be served with the claim form and particulars of claim not less than 21 days before the hearing date. ## Defendant’s response and adding of sub-holder as a party

## 55.35

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.35] (1) An acknowledgment of service is not required and Part 10 does not apply. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.35] (2) Where, in any Renting Homes possession claim, the defendant does not file a defence within the time specified in rule 15.4, the defendant may take part in any hearing but the court may take their failure to do so into account when deciding what order to make about costs. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.35] (3) Part 12 (default judgment) does not apply in a claim to which this Section applies. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.35] (4) Where a sub-holder applies to the court to be added as a party to proceedings, the court must add them as a defendant if they are entitled to be a party under section 65(4) 15 of the 2016 Act. ## The hearing

## 55.36

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.36] (1) At the hearing fixed in accordance with rule 55.34 or at any adjournment of that hearing, the court may—

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.36] (a)decide the claim; or

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.36] (b)give case management directions. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.36] (2) Where the claim is genuinely disputed on grounds which appear to be substantial, case management directions given under paragraph (1)(b) will include the allocation of the claim to a track or directions to enable it to be allocated. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.36] (3) Except where—

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.36] (a)the claim is allocated to the fast track, the intermediate track or the multi-track; or

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.36] (b)the court orders otherwise,

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.36] any fact that needs to be proved by the evidence of witnesses at a hearing referred to in paragraph (1) may be proved by evidence in writing. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.36] (4) All witness statements must be filed and served at least 2 days before the hearing. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.36] (5) Where the claimant serves the claim form and particulars of claim, the claimant must produce at the hearing a certificate of service of those documents and rule 6.17(2)(a) does not apply. ## Allocation

## 55.37

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.37] (1) When the court decides the track for a Renting Homes possession claim, the matters it must consider include—

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.37] (a)the matters set out in rule 26.13 as modified by the relevant practice direction;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.37] (b)the amount of any arrears of rent;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.37] (c)the importance to the defendant of retaining possession of the dwelling;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.37] (d)the importance of vacant possession to the claimant; and

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.37] (e)if applicable, the alleged conduct of the defendant. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.37] (2) The court may only allocate Renting Homes possession claims to the small claims track if all the parties agree. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.37] (3) Where a Renting Homes possession claim has been allocated to the small claims track the claim must be treated, for the purposes of costs, as if it were proceeding on the fast track except that trial costs are to be in the discretion of the court and must not exceed the amount that would be recoverable under Part 45 if the value of the claim were up to £3,000. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.37] (4) Where all the parties agree the court may, when it allocates the claim, order that rule 27.14 (costs on the small claims track) applies and, where it does so, paragraph (3) does not apply. ## Electronic issue of certain Renting Homes possession claims

## 55.38

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.38] (1) A practice direction may make provision for a claimant to start certain types of Renting Homes possession claim in certain courts by requesting the issue of a claim form electronically. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.38] (2) The practice direction may, in particular—

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.38] (a)provide that only particular provisions apply in specific courts;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.38] (b)specify—

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.38] (i)the type of claim which may be issued electronically;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.38] (ii)the conditions that a claim must meet before it may be issued electronically;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.38] (c)specify the court where the claim may be issued;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.38] (d)enable the parties to make certain applications or take further steps in relation to the claim electronically;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.38] (e)specify the requirements that must be fulfilled in relation to such applications or steps;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.38] (f)enable the parties to correspond electronically with the court about the claim;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.38] (g)specify the requirements that must be fulfilled in relation to electronic correspondence;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.38] (h)provide how any fee payable on the filing of any document is to be paid where the document is filed electronically. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.38] (3) The practice direction may disapply or modify these Rules as appropriate in relation to claims started electronically. ## V RENTING HOMES WALES – ACCELERATED POSSESSION CLAIMS OF DWELLINGS LET ON A STANDARD CONTRACT

## Interpretation

## 55.39

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.39] The definitions set out in rule 55.30 apply to this Section also. ## When this Section may be used

## 55.40

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.40] (1) The claimant may bring a Renting Homes possession claim under this Section of this Part where—

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.40] (a)the claim is brought under—

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.40] (i)section 170 16 of the 2016 Act to recover possession of a dwelling let under a periodic standard contract (following contract-holder’s notice);

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.40] (ii)section 178 17 of the 2016 Act to recover possession of a dwelling let under a periodic standard contract (landlord’s notice);

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.40] (iii)section 186 18 of the 2016 Act to recover possession of a dwelling let under a fixed term standard contract (landlord’s notice at end of fixed term);

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.40] (iv)section 191 19 of the 2016 Act to recover possession of a dwelling let under a fixed term standard contract (following contract-holder’s break clause); or

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.40] (v)section 199 20 of the 2016 Act to recover possession of a dwelling let on a fixed term standard contract (landlord’s break clause); and

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.40] (b)all the conditions listed in rule 55.41 are satisfied. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.40] (2) The claimant may make the claim at any County Court hearing centre, unless an enactment provides otherwise. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.40] (3) The claim is to be issued by the hearing centre where the claim is made. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.40] (4) If the hearing centre where the claim is made does not serve the address where the dwelling is situated, the claim is to be sent, after issue, to the hearing centre serving that address. ## Conditions

## 55.41

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.41] The conditions referred to in rule 55.40(1)(b) are that—

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.41] (a)the only purpose of the claim is to recover possession of the dwelling and no other claim is made;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.41] (b)the claim relates to an occupation contract which is a standard contract; and

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.41] (c)a prescribed notice in accordance with any of the following sections of the 2016 Act was given to the contract-holder—

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.41] (i)section 171 (if the claim is brought under section 170 21 of that Act);

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.41] (ii)section 173 (if the claim is brought under section 178 22 of that Act);

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.41] (iii)section 186 23 (if the claim is brought under that section);

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.41] (iv)section 192 (if the claim is brought under section 19 24 of that Act); or

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.41] (v)section 194 25 (if the claim is brought under section 199 26 of that Act). ## Claim form

## 55.42

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.42] (1) The claim form must—

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.42] (a)be in the form specified in Practice Direction 55A; and

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.42] (b)contain all information and be accompanied by all documents as are required by that form. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.42] (2) The court is to serve the claim form by first class post (or an alternative service which provides for delivery on the next working day). ## Defence

## 55.43

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.43] (1) A defendant who wishes to—

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.43] (a)oppose the claim; or

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.43] (b)seek a postponement of possession in accordance with rule 55.47,

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.43] must file a defence within 14 days after service of the claim form. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.43] (2) The defence must be in the form specified in Practice Direction 55A. ## Claim referred to judge

## 55.44

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.44] (1) On receipt of the defence the court must—

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.44] (a)send a copy to the claimant; and

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.44] (b)refer the claim and defence to a judge. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.44] (2) Where the period set out in rule 55.43 has expired without the defendant filing a defence—

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.44] (a)the claimant may file a written request for an order for possession; and

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.44] (b)the court must refer that request to a judge. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.44] (3) Where the defence is received after the period set out in rule 55.43 has expired but before a request is filed in accordance with paragraph (2), paragraph (1) still applies. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.44] (4) Where—

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.44] (a)the period set out in rule 55.43 has expired without the defendant filing a defence; and

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.44] (b)the claimant has not made a request for an order for possession under paragraph (2) within 3 months after the expiry of the period set out in rule 55.43, the claim must be stayed. ## Consideration of the claim

## 55.45

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.45] (1) After considering the claim and any defence, the judge may—

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.45] (a)make an order for possession under rule 55.46 without requiring the attendance of the parties;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.45] (b)strike out the claim if the claim form discloses no reasonable grounds for bringing the claim; or

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.45] (c)where paragraphs (2) or (3) apply—

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.45] (i)direct that a date be fixed for a hearing; and

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.45] (ii)give any appropriate case management directions. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.45] (2) This paragraph applies where the judge is not satisfied either that the claim form was served or that the claimant has established that they are entitled to recover possession from the defendant.
